summary: The sole prior Unicode emission blocker is resolved: invalid exposed text is dropped without escaping the callback or logging, and the next delivered event reports the sequence gap and cumulative drop. All 16 deploy/hermes tests pass; approval is limited to this adapter fix, not production eligibility or full M3 acceptance.

scope.review_type: Bounded independent re-review of the Unicode fix and its regression tests; earlier reviewed fixes and runtime evidence are not reopened.

unicode_regression.transport: Real nonblocking AF_UNIX datagrams through registered adapter callbacks
assertions_verified: No callback exception, log, stdout or stderr for lone-surrogate text
Invalid event produces no datagram, advances sequence once and increments dropped once
Subsequent valid event is delivered with the sequence gap and dropped=1
Subsequent request identity is preserved literally and private invalid text is absent

verification.code_review: Encoding is inside a narrow UnicodeEncodeError handler under the existing serialized emission lock. The handler increments dropped once and returns before send; valid serialization and the existing socket-error handling are unchanged. No new secrets, shell execution, permissions, network behavior or broad exception suppression were introduced.
verification.runtime_probes: Not rerun in this bounded review; parent will run both probes and whole-repository tests. No network/model calls, installs, permission/profile changes or HERMES_YOLO_MODE bypass were used. The evidence document still includes HERMES_YOLO_MODE in its historical command; this review does not endorse or rely on that bypass.

integration_decision: The prior Unicode blocker is cleared for the narrow adapter change. Parent final whole-repository verification and both no-bypass runtime probes remain separate acceptance steps. This verdict does not establish production ingestion, physical request association, routing safety, model quality/savings, or complete M3.
